desc: Build an MST using Kruskal's algorithm on the given graph, storing the parent and weight of each edge that is added to the tree.
Count the multiplicities of each vertex in sequences A and B (how many times each vertex appears as an A_i and as a B_i).
Run a second DSU (disjoint set union) on the MST, processing its edges in non‑decreasing order of weight, and greedily match as many A‑B pairs as possible at each join, accumulating the weighted sum.
Print the accumulated sum as the answer.
